segments.text: Phil and Luke believe there may be some kind of treasure hidden under their house. They’re both excited to look for it, but Phil is secretly terrified of the dark space and the insects under there.
segments.tts_text: [a natural conversational storyteller] Phil and Luke believe there may be some kind of treasure hidden under their house. They’re both excited to look for it, but Phil is secretly terrified of the dark space and the insects under there.

segments.text: Instead of going in, he sends Luke’s remote-controlled truck down with a camera attached to it.
segments.tts_text: [a storyteller building gentle suspense] Instead of going in, he sends Luke’s remote-controlled truck down with a camera attached to it.

segments.text: Phil loses control of the truck, and Luke is upset because it was a Christmas present from Jay. Luke finally crawls under the house to get it himself, but his belt gets caught on a pipe.

segments.text: As soon as Phil hears that his son is trapped, he forgets about his own fear and goes in to help him.

segments.text: After Phil frees Luke, they decide to keep exploring together. They soon find what look like dead bodies and run out screaming. The police arrive, but the bodies turn out to be old Halloween decorations left by the previous owner.

segments.text: Meanwhile, Haley is taking her driving test for the third time. She’s so nervous that Claire tells her to take three deep breaths and relax. Unfortunately, Haley gets the same strict examiner who failed her before.

segments.text: During the test, Haley becomes overwhelmed and starts crying. The examiner admits that she reminds him of his own daughter, which is exactly why he wants her to become a safe driver. He gives her another chance, and she finally passes.

segments.text: Alex is also nervous about going to a school dance because she’s afraid no one will ask her to dance. Claire gives her the same advice she gave Haley: take three deep breaths and relax.

segments.text: At Jay and Gloria’s house, Manny pretends to be sick so he can avoid a birthday party at an amusement park. Gloria knows he’s really afraid of the roller coaster, so she and Jay trick him into going.

segments.text: Mitchell and Cameron invite Lily’s pediatrician over for brunch because they want to become her favorite patients. During the meal, Lily suddenly says “Mommy.” Cameron is heartbroken and starts worrying that Lily needs a mother.
segments.tts_text: [empathetic] Mitchell and Cameron invite Lily’s pediatrician over for brunch because they want to become her favorite patients. During the meal, Lily suddenly says “Mommy.” Cameron is heartbroken and starts worrying that Lily needs a mother.

segments.text: The doctor tells them that Lily is lucky to have two fathers who care so much about her. Later, they discover that Lily’s doll says “Mommy” when it’s squeezed. Lily was only copying the sound, and both fathers are relieved.

segments.text: By the end, everyone is still afraid of something. But whether it’s a dark space, a roller coaster, a driving test, or being a good parent, it becomes easier when someone is there with you.
